biotools.summary: The Musa Germplasm Information System (MGIS) is a database containing information on Musa (banana) germplasm diversity, including passport data, morphology, and molecular information. It has been expanded to incorporate in situ observations sourced from iNaturalist, GBIF, and other resources.
